thread.first_post_html:
This thread is being created to help those see what their setup will look like before they purchase it. Please follow my example and post your information as I do mine. Any posts made not resembling mine will be deleted. Please keep any questions to PM regarding a setup. Please include as much information as possible about your setup that could affect the overall height of your truck. Any change is greatly accepted, even if it is just a tire size different and still stock.

Model
2wd or 4wd

Torsion bar Rating or Code:

Torsion bar keys if any
Lift Blocks?
Add-A-Leafs?
Body Lift?
Aftermarket Bumpers?
Fender Height Measurements
Any fender or body trimming needed? (If so where?)
If you see something I missed, please let me know and I will add it.

rewrite.rewritten_title: Setup Examples for 4WD Chevrolet and GMC Trucks
rewrite.summary: This thread showcases various setups from forum members, detailing their truck configurations including tires, wheels, lift kits, and body modifications.
seo_outline: Common modifications across different years and models
rewrite.rewritten_article_markdown:
This thread showcases various setups from forum members for 4WD Chevrolet and GMC trucks. Each post provides detailed information on the truck's configuration, including tires, wheels, lift kits, and body modifications. Users are encouraged to include as much information as possible about their setup that could affect overall height.

### Year
- 1989 GMC Jimmy SLE: 4WD, 35x12.50x15, 4" Superlift soft ride suspension lift, 4" rear lift blocks, powder coated bumpers (Post ID: 291)
- 1996 Chevrolet Tahoe: 4WD, 33x1250, 4-6" Superlift, GK T-bars cranked 1", Purple keys, 5.5" Pro Comp blocks, rear ranch hand bumper and front grill guard (Post ID: 289)

### Make & Model
- Chevrolet Z71 K1500 Stepside Extended Cab: 4WD, 38.5x15 Boggers, 6" Superlift/6" Skyjacker leafs, Rough Country(GL) bars cranked 3", 3" blocks, 3" body lift (Post ID: 278)
- Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Z71 Extended Cab: 4WD, 36x14.50 TSL-SX's, Rancho 6", GL Torsion Bars cranked all the way (2.5"s), 5.5" Superlift Lift Blocks, 3" Pro Comp Add-A-Leafs, 3" Performance Accessories Body Lift (Post ID: 281)

### Tire Size
- 36x14.50x16 Truxus STS on 16x10 American Eagle Series 054 wheels (2001 Silverado) (Post ID: 280)
- BF Goodrich Mud Terrains 315/75/16 with Ultra Type 182 16X8s (1999 Chevrolet LS) (Post ID: 281)

### Body & Fender Modifications
- Slight front lower fender trim and valance trim on 2003 Silverado (Post ID: 285)
- Bushwhacker Pocket Flares cover minor trimming the tires performed early on (1995 K1500 Z71) (Post ID: 288)

### Visual Representations
- Various photos of setups from different members, showcasing their modified trucks (Post IDs: [278, 279, 280, 281, 282, 283, 284, 285, 286, 287, 288, 289, 290, 291, 292, 293, 294, 295, 296])

post_rewrites.rewritten_content:
This thread aims to help potential buyers visualize their setup before purchasing by providing detailed information about their truck modifications. Please follow the format below:

- Year, Make, Model, 2WD or 4WD
- Tire Size
- Wheel Size
- Lift Kit (size and brand if not stock)
- Torsion Bar Rating or Code: Cranked or not, and extent of cranking if applicable
- Torsion Bar Keys (if any)
- Lift Blocks?
- Add-A-Leafs?
- Body Lift?
- Aftermarket Bumpers?
- Fender Height Measurements
- Any fender or body trimming needed? (Specify locations)

If you notice any missing information, please let me know and I will update the list.

1999 GMC Yukon 4WD with 38.5x15 Boggers tires, 16x10 American Racing Atlas Superlift suspension (6 inches), 6-inch Skyjacker leaf springs, Rough Country GL bars, 3-inch lift blocks, and a 3-inch body lift, resulting in approximately 51 inches of ground clearance both front and rear.

1994 Chevrolet Z71 K1500 Stepside Extended Cab 4WD features a TSL-SX's 15x10 American Eagle Series 054 wheels with Rancho 4-6" Torsion Bars (Code GH), set to maximum lift of 2.5 inches, combined with 5.5-inch Superlift Lift Blocks and 3-inch Pro Comp Add-A-Leaves. Additionally, a 3-inch Performance Accessories Body Lift is installed for a total front lift of 51 inches and rear lift of 51 inches.

2001 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD Extended Cab, 4WD. Equipped with Truxus STS 16x10 wheels, American Eagle Series 102 tires. Features Rancho GL torsion bars for a lifted appearance. Torsion bars have been cranked 2 inches, and the vehicle is fitted with a 5-inch superlift lift kit. Front suspension is raised to 49 inches, rear to 49 inches (will verify measurements tonight).

1999 Chevrolet Silverado LS 2WD with BF Goodrich Mud Terrain tires (315/75R16), equipped with Ultra Type 182 spindles and a 3-inch lift block. Additional modifications include 2-inch Daytona coil spacers, a 3-inch Performance Accessories body lift, and a Ranch Hand "Cowboy" rear bumper. Front fender clearance is approximately 43 inches, while the rear is about 42 inches. Note: The interior of the front wheel wells was trimmed, and the corner of the front bumper and air dam were also trimmed, though the bumper cut was not strictly necessary.

1997 Chevrolet Silverado 4WD with 33x12.50x15 BFG MT tires, Rock Creek 15x10 wheels, and a Superlift suspension for 4-6" lift. Stock tubular bumper (TB) with 1" crank-fabbed front bumpers. Equipped with Ford keys and rear shackle flips. AAL Reunel and XD9000i winch rated at 350 lbs. Front wheel wells trimmed, rear not modified.Suspension height: ~40", ~41".

2000 Chevy Silverado 1500 Z71 4WD with 36x14.5 and 16x10 tires. Equipped with a 5.5" Superlift rear leaf spring and a 3" PA body lift. Also features rear roll pan; measurements need to be taken later. Stock no-lift blocks are used. Max torque is 5913. Old photo available.

2003 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Extended Cab, short bed, 4WD Z71 equipped with 16x8 Ion Alloy 170 Series wheels and 315/75R16 Nitto Terra Grapplers tires. Features include six Pro Comp reservoir shocks with dual shock hoops, 2-inch after-market lift blocks (A.A.L.) removed, and 2-3.5 inch Pro Comp blocks. Front wheel well is 44.25 inches wide, rear is 43 inches. Lower valance and fender trim were installed to prevent rubbing during off-road turns.

2000 Chevy Silverado 1500 Z71 EXTCAB, 4WD, with a 36x14.50x16 tire setup on 16-inch wheels at the front and 10-inch wheels in the rear. Rancho suspension lift with torsion bar rating WY (max torque 5913). Stock torsion bar keys are used, along with 5-inch rear lift blocks and a 2-inch rear anti-angle bar. A 3-inch body lift is also present. The front features a Tahoe Z71 bumper, and the rear has a Ranchhand bumper. Fender height measurements are not recalled; however, there are slight modifications to the front lower fender trim and valance trim.

1989 GMC Jimmy SLE 4WD with a 4" superlift and 4" rear lift blocks. Features include powder-coated front and rear bumpers, soft ride suspension, and fender height measurements not provided. No trimming is necessary.

1996 Chevrolet Tahoe, 4WD, 33-inch tires, 15x10 wheels, 4-6" superlift with GK T-bars, 1-inch cranked suspension, purple keys, 5.5-inch Pro Comp airlocks, rear ranch-hand bumper, and front grill guard.

2002 GMC Sierra 4WD with ECSB suspension, 36x13.50x20 IROK wheels, 20x8.5 RVM Impasto Black rims, and 6" lift. Equipped with Ford keys, a barely turned 5.5-inch block, and AAL Road Armor Stealth bumpers (45" front, 46" rear ground to fender). Slightly rubs on the back of the fenders during big bumps.

The Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD EC/LB from 2002 has a 4WD configuration with 315/75R16 BFGoodrich All-Terrain tires. It features a 2-inch rear lift and a 3-inch PA body lift, resulting in front fender height measurements of 45.5 inches and rear measurements of 46.5 inches. There is a slight air dam trim on the front, inner plastic wheel well trimming at the rear, and minor metal trim at the bottom of the front fenders behind the plastic liner. Note that no 16x10 wheels are shown in the accompanying photo.

2004 Chevy Silverado 1500 Regular Cab, 4WD, 37x12.50x17 BFG M/T tires, 17x10 MB Motoring shocks, 6" ProComp lift, 5" Superlift rear leaf springs, 3" Rough Country (PA) body lift. Slight trimming on lower valance; exact measurements to be confirmed later.
2003 Chevrolet Silverado Extended Cab, 4WD, 305/70/R16 tires, 16x10 wheels, 4-inch Rancho suspension lift, stock t-bars (not cranked), 43-inch fenders (front and rear).

2002 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD, 6.0L V8, 4WD, 315/70R-17 BFGoodrich All-Terrain T/A tires on 17x9 Eagle Alloys with Cognito HD leveling kit and stock HD tubular bumper. Four tires on the driver's side, three on the passenger side. Equipped with Green Key Z71 rear air lift bags (3" up front, 47.5" in back). Inner plastic fenders trimmed for tire clearance, lower air dam modified.

2006 GMC Sierra SLT 2500HD, 6.0L V8, 4WD, 295/70R-17 Nitto All-Terrain tires on 17x9 Gunners with chrome wheels and stock HD tubular bumper. Four tires on the driver's side, three on the passenger side. Equipped with Green Key Z71 rear air lift bags. Inner plastic fenders trimmed for tire clearance, lower air dam modified.

1998 GMC T-bodies equipped with a 1.5"-2" rear block, 3" body lift, 9000x series shocks, 305/70R-16 Goodyear AT/S tires, 16x8 wheels with 4" backspacing, and Procomp 1079s. Fenders measure 41" all around, showing no rub.

2000 Chevrolet Silverado 4WD with 315/75R16 tires, 16x10 wheels. Features include 4" BS lift, 6" super lift, and a 3" body lift. Stock bars are not cranked, and there are no additional leaf blocks. Equipped with Ranch Hand bumpers front and rear. The front inner fender has undergone extensive cutting.
